267287|83e0509a.name: Sylassa Moonglow
267287|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

277024|589a8d2d.name: Jelinek Sharpshear
277024|589a8d2d.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

1638-complete.name: Harry Burlguard
1638-complete.text:
Oh ho!  Have a drink with me, lad.  You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!

Or... were you here for a lesson?
1638-complete.title: A Warrior's Training

1665-progress.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-progress.text: I saw your fight with Bartleby.  Nicely done!  Did you get his mug?
1665-progress.title: Bartleby's Mug

1667-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
1667-progress.text: Do you have my badge? I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.
1667-progress.title: Dead-tooth Jack

1686-progress.name: Elanaria
1686-progress.text: Have you defeated the Shade of Elura, $N?  And do you have the lost elunite ore?
1686-progress.title: The Shade of Elura

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2518-progress.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-progress.text:
I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
2518-progress.title: Tears of the Moon

2541-progress.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-progress.text: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
2541-progress.title: The Sleeping Druid

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, master.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

333-progress.name: Rema Schneider
333-progress.text: You bring word from Mr. Bagley?
333-progress.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply

334-progress.name: Thurman Schneider
334-progress.text: Are you here to buy clothes?
334-progress.title: Package for Thurman

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

483-progress.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-progress.text:
$N, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.
483-progress.title: The Relics of Wakening

486-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
486-complete.text:
$N, you have proven yourself a most worthy and able $c. A $r who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.

May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
486-complete.title: Ursal the Mauler

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, lad?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

7383-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-progress.text: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
7383-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91740-complete.name: Merell Ross
91740-complete.text: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $c. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
91740-complete.title: Croaky's Head

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

935-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-progress.text:
I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

Whatever it is, please make it quick.
935-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-complete.text: Thank you for your aid so far--it has been of great relief. Let me inspect these belts to see if we can glean any insights as to the harpy aggression.
937-complete.title: The Enchanted Glade

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

940-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-progress.text: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $c. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
940-progress.title: Teldrassil

97923-complete.name: Gelman Stonehand
97923-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97923-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

98046-accept.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
98046-accept.text:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $c. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

98046-complete.name: Lariia
98046-complete.text:
Do not mind the Arch Druid, $N. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.

Wait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?
98046-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-accept.name: Lariia
98065-accept.text:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-complete.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
98065-complete.text:
Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.

<Tyrande's face settles.>

I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.

Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.

Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.
98065-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-progress.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
98065-progress.text: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
98065-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

98392-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-accept.text:
These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392-accept.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-complete.text:
<Arynia investigates the amulets.>

Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.

I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.

I will inform my superiors of this at once.
98392-complete.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

98398-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98398-accept.text:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $N. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398-accept.title: The Oracle Tree

98398-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98398-complete.text: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
98398-complete.title: The Oracle Tree

98403-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-accept.text:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

98403-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-complete.text:
I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.

I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.

Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we keep this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.

I trust you to do the same.
98403-complete.title: Twisted Hatred

98403-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-progress.text:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
98403-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

99046-complete.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99046-complete.text: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...
99046-complete.title: The Lost Runner

99047-accept.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99047-accept.text:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047-accept.title: Not Dead Yet

99047-complete.name: Byancie
99047-complete.text:
The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.

We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
99047-complete.title: Not Dead Yet

99050-accept.name: Byancie
99050-accept.text:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050-accept.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-complete.name: Byancie
99050-complete.text:
Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.

Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
99050-complete.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-progress.name: Byancie
99050-progress.text: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050-progress.title: The Great Tree Provides

99053-accept.name: Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom
99053-accept.text:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053-accept.title: Escaping Ban'ethil

99053-complete.name: Sentinel Kyra Starsong
99053-complete.text:
Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.

Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.
99053-complete.title: Escaping Ban'ethil

99073-accept.name: Byancie
99073-accept.text:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073-accept.title: Easing Suffering

99073-complete.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99073-complete.text: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>
99073-complete.title: Easing Suffering

99073-progress.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99073-progress.text: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
99073-progress.title: Easing Suffering
